hana (ACME): Hi team — after the model rollout earlier today (rdl-infer-2026-03) our TypeScript codegen now produces code that fails tsc. Looks like helper functions aren't being emitted and several exports are missing. This started right after the 09:12 UTC rollout.

samir: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a failing snippet + the exact tsc errors? Also which model id and prompt you used?

hana (ACME): Sure — minimal failing example from the generated file attached by customer:```ts
export const createWidget = (opts) => ({
  __assign({}, opts),
  helper: __privateHelper()
});
```
tsc output:```
src/gen.ts:5:3 - error TS2304: Cannot find name '__assign'.
src/gen.ts:6:12 - error TS2304: Cannot find name '__privateHelper'.
```
We also see `export { default } from './runtime'` removed in some files. Model id: `rdl-infer-2026-03-09-a` Prompt: "Generate a TypeScript utility that merges options and calls an internal helper to normalise input"

leo: tagging in eng-ml — initial hypothesis: a recent change to the helper-injection pass (PR #4023) attempted to strip TS runtime helpers for ES target but looks like our AST rewrite removed the `__assign/__rest` polyfills entirely instead of switching to native syntax. Could be a regression in the emitter for small factory functions.

maya: can we get a reproducible curl so support can forward to SRE/ML?

samir: customer provided this repro curl (sanitized):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rdl-infer-2026-03-09-a","prompt":"Generate a TypeScript utility that merges options and calls an internal helper to normalise input","max_tokens":256}'
```
Response (truncated):```ts
export function build(opts) {
  return __assign({}, opts, { norm: __normalize(opts) });
}
```
leo: ok copying this to an internal reproducer. Quick ask for the customer: do you have a target tsconfig (target/ES version) and are you running any post-processing (prettier, babel)?

hana (ACME): tsconfig target is `es2019`, no babel, we run prettier but that's just formatting. The compiled artifact fails before prettier touches it.

samir: created internal ticket CS-4521 and escalated to eng-ml and runtime. support-bot: Ticket CS-4521 created and linked to incident tracker: https://internal.redwood/cs/4521

leo: preliminary local repro achieved with same model and ts target. Looks like the emitter pass that inlines helpers was toggled off for small modules — fallback omitted. I will open a hotfix branch to re-enable helper injection and add a unit test for ts targets < es2020. ETA for patch: ~4 hours. @juan @sasha can you review the rollout plan?

juan: will stand by for the patch. If we push a hotfix we should canary in prod region us-west-2 with 5% traffic and watch `tsc-failures` metric and customer reports.

sasha: agree. I'll prepare a brief rollback playbook in case the patch introduces other regressions.

samir: Hana — telling customer we have a hotfix in progress and will canary tonight. Apologize and request they pin to previous model variant for now (rdl-infer-2026-02).

hana (ACME): thanks, we can pin for now. Please keep us posted, this blocks our deploy. :pray: 

deploy-bot: Deployed canary job created for hotfix branch hf/emit-helper-reinstate — canary target: us-west-2 5%

leo: will post updates in this thread once canary metrics look good or if further issues.

maya: adding this to the post-release checklist items: add ts helper injection tests + add a regression alert on `generated-ts-unresolved-symbols` metric.

samir: moving to monitoring & follow-up. closing loop when patch is live and ACME confirms. :thumbsup:
